facts.value: Students may meet any one or a combination of the following options, provided that three distinct laboratory-based science courses are completed with a 2.00 unweighted GPA or higher.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Three years of high school laboratory sciences in three different subject areas, preferably biology, chemistry, earth science or physics.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: A laboratory-based integrated science course may be allowed to substitute for one of the three lab sciences. Each course should be one year in length.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Additionally, a laboratory-based advanced science course may be allowed to substitute for one of the three lab sciences. An advanced science class is a lab science that is generally taken in the last two years of high school.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: An advanced placement course, a higher-level international baccalaureate course, a dual enrollment course, or other honors course for which the previous lab science course is a prerequisite.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Minimum test scores in three standardized tests from three different subject matters.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: SAT II subject test score in chemistry-600, biology-590, physics-620 or ACT test score in science-20.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Three transferable 4-credit college laboratory science courses from biology, chemistry, earth science or physics.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: An integrated laboratory science or advanced-level laboratory-based science may be substituted for one of these laboratory subjects.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: ASU requires students to complete three different lab sciences.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: If ASU requires additional information regarding your lab sciences, a Priority Task called Course Description will be displayed on My ASU.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: Have your high school submit your lab sciences to the courseapproval.asu.edu website or submit a course description form for each lab science taken in an accredited online high school environment.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: Meet one of the following: two years of the same high school second language; attainment of minimum score on a national standardized second language test; placement into a third semester college second language class based on university placement exam results; or two transferable 3- or 4-credit, college-level courses in the same second language.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: One year of high school American history.

metadata.chunk_title: Social science competency requirement + Fine arts or career and technical education competency requirement

facts.value: Minimum SAT II subject test score of 560 on American history/social studies.

metadata.chunk_title: Social science competency requirement + Fine arts or career and technical education competency requirement

facts.value: One transferable 3-credit college American history course.

metadata.chunk_title: Social science competency requirement + Fine arts or career and technical education competency requirement

facts.value: One year of high school social science (e.g., European history, world history, economics, sociology, geography, government, psychology or anthropology).

metadata.chunk_title: Social science competency requirement + Fine arts or career and technical education competency requirement

facts.value: Minimum SAT II subject test score of 580 on world history.

metadata.chunk_title: Social science competency requirement + Fine arts or career and technical education competency requirement

facts.value: One transferable 3-credit college social science course.

metadata.chunk_title: Social science competency requirement + Fine arts or career and technical education competency requirement

facts.value: One year (or a combination of two semesters) of high school fine arts or career and technical education.

metadata.chunk_title: Social science competency requirement + Fine arts or career and technical education competency requirement

facts.value: One transferable 3-credit college fine arts course.

metadata.chunk_title: Social science competency requirement + Fine arts or career and technical education competency requirement

facts.value: Applicants who have completed their junior and senior years in a U.S. high school must have an SAT EBRW score of 580 taken after April 2016 or an ACT English score of 23.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information - Part 2

facts.value: Applicants must have completed a minimum of 48 transferable semester credits including six credits of freshman English composition at a U.S. college or university with a cumulative GPA of 2.50 or higher.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information - Part 2

facts.value: Applicants holding a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. college or university are eligible.
